profile_text.body:
The Technology Innovation Institute (TII) describes itself as a leading global scientific research center and the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council (ATRC). It is a government lab founded in 2020 and is not for profit. Its Falcon LLM website presents Falcon as a generative large language model intended to advance applications and use cases, and it highlights Falcon Perception, a multimodal AI model that combines vision and language capabilities so systems can see, read, and understand images using natural language prompts.

The site lists several Falcon family models. Falcon 180B is described as having 180 billion parameters and trained on 3.5 trillion tokens, and the site says it is at the top of the Hugging Face Leaderboard for pre-trained Open Large Language Models. Falcon 40B is described as trained on 40 billion parameters and one trillion tokens and as the first home-grown open source large language model released with weights for research and commercial use. The site also mentions Falcon-H1, Falcon-E, Falcon Arabic, Falcon Mamba 7B, Falcon 2 11B, and Falcon 10B, and it claims Falcon-H1 outperforms Meta's LLaMA and Alibaba's Qwen while Falcon 2 11B outperforms Meta's Llama 3 8B and performs on par with Google Gemma 7B as independently verified by the Hugging Face Leaderboard. TII also announced the Falcon Foundation, a non-profit dedicated to open-source generative AI models, and AI71, an AI company launched by ATRC and VentureOne.

Falcon (TII) is a UAE-hosted open-source LLM with Apache 2.0 licensing, sovereign AI positioning, and Middle East data residency.
